responsibility: Implements SSA-based mathematical simplifications and arithmetic pattern rewrites that are not tied to a single language front end. It performs optimizations such as reciprocal CSE for repeated divisions, widening multiply/add transformations, fused multiply-add formation, highpart/divmod and arithmetic-overflow pattern matching, selected conditional rewrites such as spaceship-style compares, and related dominator-walk driven math cleanups on GIMPLE.
same_name_distinction: Implements the full SSA math-optimization passes and transformations, including reciprocal CSE, widening multiply/add rewrites, FMA formation, divmod/highpart patterns, overflow matching, and related dominator-walk logic. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa-math-opts.h, it is the optimization implementation rather than the small shared helper interface.
